decode_video_pyav: decode a video file using the PyAV backend with temporal sampling and optional audio extraction
decode_video_torchvision: decode a video file using the TorchVision backend with temporal sampling and metadata tracking
temporal_sample_frames: temporally sample a uniform set of frames from a video tensor between given start and end indices
get_clip_start_end_indices: compute start and end frame indices for a video clip with random or uniform sampling
pyav_decode_stream: decode a subset of video frames from a PyAV container within a specified PTS range
